findings.description: Four metal cups are clearly present on the table from 00:00 to 00:03 (front-left, center, right, and rear). As the camera pulls back between 00:03 and 00:05, the rear cup vanishes from the tabletop without being touched or removed by either hand, leaving only three cups for the remainder of the clip.
